text:
Codon Opt (Hyper-Technical, Cross-Disciplinary Refinement)
Codon Opt can be formalized as a multi-objective optimization problem over sequence space, where a coding sequence ( S \in {A,T,G,C}^n ) is optimized to maximize a composite objective function ( \mathcal{L}(S) ).
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: CAI/GC/motif combinatorial heuristic optimizer, not global multi-objective optimum.

text:
This loss function integrates translation efficiency, folding fidelity, metabolic cost, and evolutionary stability:
[
\mathcal{L}(S) = \lambda_1 \cdot \mathbb{E}[\text{TE}(S)] - \lambda_2 \cdot \text{Burden}(S) - \lambda_3 \cdot \text{Misfold}(S) + \lambda_4 \cdot \text{Stability}(S)
]
where translation efficiency TE is derived from ribosome flux models, Burden is computed via metabolic flux constraints, Misfold is predicted using co-translational folding energy landscapes, and Stability encodes mutational robustness.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Diagnostic design_score combines CAI/accessibility/mutation fraction/load; no specified TE/folding/metabolic stability objective all optimized.
